body:
Coordinator pre-positioning: Stratospheric Swooping Zephyr → Ethereal Orbiting Eclipse

PDR-064 Moment 1 — INFORMATION TRANSFER ONLY. I (Stratospheric Swooping Zephyr, fe53ec) retain ALL routing, reviewer-dispatch, merge-serialisation, and coordination-home state-write authority, and all my monitors keep running, until Ethereal Orbiting Eclipse (f92636) broadcasts the distinct Moment-2 active-acknowledgement ("Coordinator role acknowledgement: Ethereal Orbiting Eclipse from Stratospheric Swooping Zephyr", referencing this event, declaring adopted cadence). Fired at a NATURAL BOUNDARY (all implementer lanes closed clean); owner directs transfer timing. This event is present-truth at ~01:30Z 2026-06-11; recompute live facts at your pickup (claims, comms tail, gh pr list, git log).

NAME DISCIPLINE: full name + prefix always (this arc has had two Celestials, two Airys, two Fruiteds, two Galactics).

== REQUIRED READING (you report Director-grade grounding complete 30e476fb; re-verify against this list) ==
1. Team opener (the prompt file) + plan authority frontmatter todos (graph-tools-value-redesign.plan.md).
2. eef thread record §Current Continuation — refreshed through waypoint fbbe6308 (pushed); the fourth-holder entry carries the full arc.
3. Witness report §8 + §9; the Moment-1 lineage (1d8ac145 → 56ae6447 → this event).
4. The comms stream from ~19:40Z 06-10 (one Director succession + four implementer rotations + five merges are on it).

== STATE (live at ~01:30Z) ==
- TRACK-G COMPLETE + CURED: G1 (793cb3c1), G2 (27204da0), G3 (a229d63d), year-axis re-chain (53308e1e, v1.22.0). All three graph tools anchored+bounded; factory retired; ALL eef-revalidation signals raised — the downstream re-proof plan (eef-revalidate-on-new-graph-tools) has its full input set and is the natural NEXT VALUE MOVE.
- ROSTER: NO active implementers (Eclipsed, Glassy, Sylvan, Fruited, Tempestuous all closed clean today; Tempestuous declined G4b on budget honesty — a good answer). Bench: you (Director seat). Seat provisioning is OWNER-driven (the owner has named every successor today).
- OPEN, OWNER-GATED: (1) S3 PR #162 — settled since ~20:56Z, merge waits ONLY on the owner's sign-off for the new outward prompt name curriculum-mapping (Director verdict on record: approve; NO default — ratified sign-off class). (2) G4b — unblocked, needs a fresh seat from the owner. (3) Principles-prompt attribution validation (gates S3's principles cycle only). (4) Bulk-export-lags-live (G2 datum: 2026-06-10 export serves 2026-05-21-identical content).
- DIRECTOR QUEUE (small): prerequisiteFor multiplicity (3,452 vs 2,605 unique — decide ALONGSIDE the eef-revalidation re-proof, event bbe99f11); two test flakes (lifecycle-lease; auth-routes scopes_supported) uncured; test:e2e turbo env exposure micro-PR candidate; agent-tools loud-write fixes (NOW FOUR corroborating instances: silent append, silent claims-close no-op, Celestial-Dusk's failed directed write, Tempestuous's worktree-retargeted ask 9a164c5c that nearly fired an unseen default); agent-tools rebuild from main (retires the portable-watcher caution).
- CONSOLIDATION DEBT for the next curation pass: today's failure-mode events (invisible-0x1F 4fd66dc5, four-shape watcher test 6cf5f4ab, destination-verified write-proof 9a164c5c, origin-main-baseline 54fc0fee) are comms-held; closeout consolidation reads them forward per ADR-183.

== STANDING RULINGS (cite, don't re-open) ==
Portable polling watcher ONLY until the agent-tools rebuild (four-shape pre-arm render test required — Tempestuous's recipe). Verify every CLI write's success token AND destination (absolute --comms-dir always). Drift baselines against origin/main, never branch HEAD. Two-condition transfers (~40% context approach; declined routing is not failed routing). Merge-commit convention, Director-serialised, two evidence loops + deletion-scope verification at the final surface. Owner decisions as verdict-with-default, never menus; ratified sign-off classes have NO default. Pure direction only — route dispatches, never self-dispatch. Non-major versioning through the alpha redesign. Stage by explicit pathspec; lifecycle-commit residue exception for registry-bearing bundles; pre-validate EVERY commit header against the 100-char limit (cost me two retries today).

== COORDINATION HOME ==
Primary checkout, branch docs/graph-team-direction-2026-06-10 (owner-ratified; NOT main). Waypoints this Directorship: e3590ea6, 9e3e2f1f, 75bb5f53, 2b752621, d88e4b31, fbbe6308 — all pushed. You inherit as sole writer after Moment 2. My Director claim dbe87352 closes at my hand citing your Moment-2 event.

== MOMENT-2 CHOREOGRAPHY (your moves, when the owner directs) ==
1. Re-verify foundation against this event; 2. Arm your surfaces (portable watcher w/ four-shape test, 4-min heartbeat; PR watchers as PRs open); 3. Open YOUR Director claim on the coordination boundary; 4. Broadcast the Moment-2 acknowledgement (exact title shape above, referencing this event); 5. I then close dbe87352 citing it, stop my monitors (they run until your acknowledgement lands — never dark between the moments), post team-member closeout + final heartbeat-end. Anything in flight at that instant transfers explicitly in my closeout text.

Questions by directed event before Moment 2 — my watcher is live.
